desc: The impact sound of a Boki's ability hit (BokiImpact, docs/AUDIO.md). Boki types are labels for identity and colour (DECISIONS 11-10, 19 types): each type has ONE impact, ki_<type>, the take set of its cast cue k_<type> (Sfx loads ki_ names from the k_ files, so the impact has its own voice cap and does not eat the cast). Missing file -> the shared hit/crit plays instead. Types not listed use 'default'.
